news.headline: Lula wins historic fourth term in Brazil presidential runoff
news.body: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva defeated Senator Flávio Bolsonaro in the runoff, securing a fourth non-consecutive presidential term, the electoral court said. Official results showed Lula with about 51.8% of the vote to Bolsonaro’s 48.2%, and world leaders issued rapid reactions to the outcome.
